items.question: How long does it take to get started with Podacium?
items.answer: You can create an account and start exploring in under two minutes. Basic access is free and includes introductory courses, project browsing, and sample BI dashboards. Full platform access only requires choosing a plan that fits your needs.

items.question: What types of accounts does Podacium support?
items.answer: Podacium supports three account types: Student (for learning and skill development), Freelancer (for offering services and finding projects), and Business (for hiring talent and using BI tools). You can switch between roles or combine them on a single account.

items.question: How does Podacium compare to other platforms?
items.answer: Podacium is unique in combining learning, freelancing, and business intelligence in one integrated platform. Unlike separate tools for each function, Podacium allows skills from courses to strengthen your freelancer profile, and BI insights to inform your business decisions — all in one ecosystem.

items.question: Is there a free trial for premium features?
items.answer: Yes. New users get a 14-day free trial with full access to premium features across all three pillars: unlimited courses, project posting, and BI pro analytics. No credit card is required, and you can cancel anytime during the trial period.

items.question: What support options are available?
items.answer: All users have access to our documentation, knowledge base, and community forums. Premium plans include email and live chat support. Enterprise clients receive priority support with a dedicated account manager and guaranteed response times.

items.question: How does Podacium protect my data and privacy?
items.answer: Podacium employs enterprise-grade security including encryption at rest and in transit, regular security audits, and strict access controls. We comply with GDPR and data protection regulations. You maintain full ownership of your data and can export or delete it anytime.

items.question: Does Podacium offer API access for integrating with my existing tools?
items.answer: Yes. Podacium provides a REST API for programmatic access to courses, projects, datasets, and user management. The API is available on Business and Enterprise plans with rate limits and authentication via API keys. Full API documentation with endpoints, examples, and SDK stubs is available in the developer section.

items.question: Can I migrate my data if I decide to leave Podacium?
items.answer: Yes. You can export all your data at any time — including course progress, certificates, project history, and BI dashboards — in industry-standard formats. Data portability is built into the platform design. Account deletion removes your personal data within 30 days per GDPR requirements.
